title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
description:
We're supporting an innovative organisation embarking on several high-profile AI transformation initiatives and are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI capabilities and real-world business outcomes.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work directly with stakeholders, product teams, and end users to understand complex business challenges and rapidly deploy AI-powered solutions. This is a highly visible role where you'll combine software engineering, AI implementation, client engagement, and problem-solving skills to deliver tangible value.

Key Responsibilities
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders to identify high-value AI use cases.
  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered applications and workflows.
  • Develop and integrate LLM-based solutions using OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or similar platforms.
  • Create custom copilots, AI agents, and automation solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical implementations.
  • Work across data engineering, software development, cloud infrastructure, and AI platforms.
  • Rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy production-ready solutions.
  • Support AI adoption, user enablement, and stakeholder engagement.
Essential Skills
  • Experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or similar.
  • Strong software engineering background with Python.
  • Experience developing applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • OpenAI / Azure OpenAI
    • Anthropic Claude
    • LangChain or LlamaIndex
    • Vector Databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB)
    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
    • AI Agent frameworks
  • Cloud experience across Azure, AWS, or GCP.
  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience delivering proofs of concept through to production deployments.
Desirable Experience
  • Agentic AI implementations.
  • Multi-agent orchestration frameworks.
  • MLOps and model deployment.
  • Knowledge Graphs.
  • Semantic search platforms.
  • Enterprise AI governance and security.
  • Experience within Financial Services, Government, Defence, Healthcare, or Enterprise SaaS environments.
